How do I start a return or an exchange?
No worries, getting a return started is pretty straightforward.
From the UK:
Go to the online returns portal and search for “Chillys”.
Enter the required info and choose how you’d like to return your items.
Outside the UK:
Post your unused items in saleable condition (no stickers on packaging) to:
Asendia UK Ltd, Unit 2B Viking Industrial Estate, Hudson Road, Bedford, MK41 0QB, United Kingdom
Good to know:
You have 30 days after delivery to return.
Returns aren’t free; postage is paid by you (except for damaged/faulty items, which you shouldn’t post back).
For bundles, you must return the entire bundle, intact and unused – not just part of it.
Keep proof of purchase handy, as it’s required.
The same process applies whether you’re effectively returning for a refund and then reordering (an “exchange”) – exchanges aren’t described separately in the info provided.
